entities.name: RRC Connection Establishment
entities.description: Procedure to establish an RRC connection, involving SRB1 establishment and transfer of initial NAS dedicated information from UE to network. Also used when UE is resuming or re-establishing RRC connection and network cannot retrieve/verify UE context.

entities.name: RRCSetupRequest
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate RRC connection establishment procedure.

entities.name: RRCSetup
entities.description: Message sent by network in response to RRCSetupRequest to establish RRC connection.

entities.name: RRCSetupComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete RRC connection establishment, contains initial NAS dedicated information.

entities.name: RRCReject
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject RRC connection establishment request.

entities.name: NAS dedicated information
entities.description: Initial NAS dedicated information/message transferred from UE to network during RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: SRB1
entities.description: Signalling Radio Bearer 1 established during RRC connection establishment procedure.

entities.name: NR sidelink transmission configured
entities.description: Condition where upper layers configure UE to transmit NR sidelink communication/discovery and related data is available for transmission.

entities.name: SIB12 configuration conditions
entities.description: Conditions related to SIB12 configuration for NR sidelink communication/discovery frequency inclusion and transmission pool availability.

entities.name: L2 U2N Relay message reception
entities.description: Condition where L2 U2N Relay UE in RRC_IDLE receives any message from L2 U2N Remote UE via SL-RLC0 or SL-RLC1.

entities.name: V2X sidelink conditions
entities.description: Conditions specified for V2X sidelink communication in TS 36.331 clause 5.3.3.1a.

relations.description: RRC connection establishment procedure begins with UE sending RRCSetupRequest message.
Network responds with RRCSetup message during RRC connection establishment.
UE completes RRC connection establishment by sending RRCSetupComplete message.
Network may reject RRC connection establishment by sending RRCReject message.
RRC connection establishment procedure establishes SRB1 signalling radio bearer.
RRCSetupComplete message contains initial NAS dedicated information element.
NR sidelink transmission configuration condition guards RRC connection establishment initiation.
SIB12 configuration conditions guard RRC connection establishment initiation for NR sidelink.
L2 U2N Relay message reception condition guards RRC connection establishment initiation.
V2X sidelink conditions guard RRC connection establishment initiation.
